_comment: Project configuration for the orchestrate plugin (aunger/dot-and-tilde, installed by .claude/install-plugins.sh). The plugin's README documents every key; test_orchestrate_config.py checks this file with the plugin's check_config.py at the commit .claude/vcs-automation-tools pins, and checks each value against this repository.
_comment_named_checks: The CI checks the Orchestrator drives to green: the three jobs of .github/workflows/test.yml. CodeQL (codeql.yml) is left off, as gallery-button-for-pixel-camera leaves it off, and so is the merge gate. A change that adds or removes a job the cycle should wait for updates this list in the same change; test_orchestrate_config.py checks that each name is a job some workflow defines.
_comment_ignored: Administrative merge holds (not failure), the job of administrative-merge-holds.yml, is the merge gate: it is red for the whole of every cycle by design, and no agent may act on it. It is left off named_checks, and ignored_check_regex leaves it out of the Monitor's verdict too (the parentheses are escaped because the value is a regex).
_comment_marker: The plugin's default marker, set here because check_config.py warns when the key is missing. Keep it once verification-plan comments use it, so later runs find them.
